settings.name_in_paper: Dueling bandits with dependent arms, utility-based weak regret, total order
unmapped: Arms have a total order: p_ij > 0.5 iff u(theta,A_i) > u(theta,A_j); otherwise p_ij arbitrary (no link-function assumption)
The learner knows the arm feature vectors A_i and the utility function u; the preference vector theta is unknown
Weak regret: zero regret if either pulled arm is optimal; utility-based weak regret r(t) = u(theta,A_1) - max of the utilities of the two pulled arms
settings.definition_quote: There are $N\geq 2$ arms, and each arm $i$ has an observable and distinct $\armdim$-dimensional feature vector $A_{i}$. Preferences between pairs of arms $i,j$ are described by fixed but unknown probabilities $p_{i,j}$... We suppose that the arms have a total order... $p_{i,j} > 0.5$ if and only if $u(\theta, A_{i})>u(\theta,A_{j})$... $r(t)=u(\theta,A_{1})-\max\{u(\theta,A_{X_{t,0}}), u(\theta,A_{X_{t,1}})\}$

symbols.M_prime: number of cells i with m_i(0) > -infinity (at most 2^N, or N! for CTB-1, O(N^{2d}) for linear utility)

conditions: arms have a total order induced by u(theta, A_i)

source.label: thm:1
source.quote: Let $\Lambda=u(\theta,A_{1})-u(\theta,A_{N})$. If $\m{1}>-\infty$, \CTB's expected cumulative regret is bounded by $\frac{(N-1)(N-2)}{2}M'\frac{p-\Delta(2p-1)}{(2p-1)^{2}}\Lambda$.

results.notes: N is the number of arms (K). The regret is defined through utilities of the pulled arms, so it is recorded as pseudo-regret. The bound is constant in T. The general implementation stores a score for each cell, which is exponential in N. Delta is the paper's prior-score offset, not a gap.

conditions: applies to a pair of arms 1<i<j (neither is the best arm)

source.label: mainLemma
source.quote: For $1<i<j$, if $\m{1} > -\infty$, we have $\mathbb{E}[N_{i,j}(t)]\leq M'\frac{p-\Delta(2p-1)}{(2p-1)^{2}}$, where $M'$ is the number of cells $i$ with $\m{i} > -\infty$, and $\Delta=\min_{s=1,\cdots M}\{\m{1}-\m{s}\}\leq 0$.

results.notes: Bound on the expected number of duels between two suboptimal arms i and j.

cited_results.setting_description: Dueling bandits, cumulative binary weak regret, arms with a total order

cited_results.cited_title: Relative upper confidence bound for the k-armed dueling bandit problem
